$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Settle Chats settings: the acpmux daemon's rule that settles (archives, with a reason) a chat whose pull requests merged or closed, or that sat idle for some days (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/hub/auto_settle.rs). The daemon reads these keys from the settings file at each pass and checks this file's defaults and ranges in its tests; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: agentSettle
lists.note: Settings > General > Settle Chats (Leo, 2026-11-18: "I know there's, like, the settle chats feature or whatever"). All off by default: settling moves a chat off the lists, so the person opts in.

rows.name: autoSettleOnMerge
rows.note: On: a chat whose pull requests are all merged or closed, at least one merged, settles (archived, tag settled=merged) once nothing runs in it. Off (the default): merges settle nothing.

title.text: Settle When Its Pull Request Merges

help.text: Moves a chat to Settled once every pull request it opened is merged or closed. Your next message brings it back.

rows.name: autoSettleOnClose
rows.note: On: a chat whose pull requests were all closed without a merge settles (tag settled=closed). Off (the default): closes settle nothing.

title.text: Settle When Its Pull Request Closes

help.text: Moves a chat to Settled once every pull request it opened was closed without a merge.

rows.name: autoSettleIdleDays
rows.note: Days with nothing new in a chat's log before it settles (tag settled=idle); 0 (the default) never.

help.text: Moves a chat to Settled after this many days with no activity. 0 never does. Running work, a pending question or a draft keeps it.
